## Yacht refit intake (demo)

Organizes a made-up refit inquiry into a clear summary and checklist.

**Fictional data only. No cost estimates, no vendors, no timelines, nothing sent. No credentials needed.**

Click **Execute workflow**, then open the last node, **Review queue**.

parameters.jsCode:

parameters.content: **Where a person decides.** Every record ends as PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW. Scope, cost, vendors and timing are human decisions and are outside this workflow.
